Nyotaimori.fact: Nyotaimori (女体盛り, 'serve (foods) on the female body'), often called "body sushi", is the Japanese practice of serving sashimi or sushi from the naked body of a woman. Fuelled by Japan's economic growth in the 1960s, this practice was further evolved by the hot spring bathing (onsen) industry in the Ishikawa Prefecture where the erotic nature of nyotaimori was used as an advertising tactic by the hot spring resorts to attract male customers who were on company trips to the region.
